description: This file contains a PHP class 'Voucher' which is part of the OpenCart admin controller namespace for managing sale vouchers. It includes methods for listing, creating, editing, and deleting vouchers, and handles HTTP request parameters, views, and interactions with models.

classes.name: Voucher
classes.description: A controller class in the OpenCart admin namespace for handling CRUD operations and views related to sale vouchers.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point that initializes the voucher listing page, setting up breadcrumbs, URLs, and loading the list view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the actual listing of vouchers, processes sorting, pagination, and rendering the voucher list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates the list of vouchers based on request parameters, fetches data from models, and prepares view data.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Handles the display and processing of the voucher creation/edit form, including loading voucher info and model interactions.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes saving a voucher, handling validation, permission checks, and updating or adding voucher records.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles deletion of selected vouchers, including permission verification and model interactions.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Displays the history of actions related to a specific voucher, including pagination and fetching historical records.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Returns the historical log for a voucher, used by the history view, incorporating pagination and data retrieval from model.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Handles sending voucher information via email, including validation, voucher selection, and triggering email dispatch.
